visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A classroom setting with a green chalkboard as the background. A male teacher in a beige cardigan and striped shirt stands at the front, facing several students seated in blue chairs at wooden desks. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a studio-simulated classroom. He speaks with expressive hand gestures. (2) A male student in a white collared shirt stands up, looking happy as his classmates, including several females with colorful pink and blonde hair, smile and applaud. The camera cuts rapidly between the teacher and the group of students. (3) Close-up shots of the teacher as he claps his hands to cue the class. He has a slightly impatient but professional facial expression, eyes squinting slightly. (4) The student gives his wishes while standing. Yellow subtitles appear at the bottom center, and variety-style text labels appear at the top. The teacher maintains a rhythmic pace by clapping between wishes. (5) The student continues speaking extensively after the celebration should have ended. The teacher looks increasingly annoyed, his posture shifting to a more closed-off stance with his hands near his waist. (6) Final shot of the teacher walking towards the chalkboard, holding a blue book, and looking back at the student with a definitive expression before instructing the class to open their textbooks.
